about.title: About Micelio
about.subtitle: A site engine built on Strapi.
about.body: Micelio publishes websites from the content you edit here. Strapi is the editor; Micelio adds the site itself, with a measured weight budget, accessibility checks and no third-party requests.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: The saved draft, as the site renders it.
preview.entry.title: Entry
preview.entry.body: The form is in the Content Manager: open it in another tab, edit and save the entry there. This page shows the saved draft and loads it again after each save.
preview.entry.bodyReadOnly: You may read this entry but not edit it. The preview shows its saved draft.
preview.entry.open: Open in the Content Manager, in a new tab
preview.entry.view: View in the Content Manager, in a new tab
preview.shortcuts: Shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+1, 2 and 3 for phone, tablet and desktop; Ctrl+Shift+S for the static site; Ctrl+Shift+Left Arrow back to the entry. On a Mac use Command instead of Ctrl. They do not work while you type in a field.
preview.frame.title: Preview of {title}
preview.blocked.title: The admin does not allow this site in a frame
preview.blocked.body: The Content Security Policy of the admin does not list {origin} in frame-src, so the browser refuses to show it. Add it to frame-src in the strapi::security config of the Strapi project and restart it. The host check on the Micelio status page reports it too.
preview.upgrade.title: Upgrade the frontend
preview.upgrade.body: The site's frontend speaks the preview protocol versions {versions}, and this plugin speaks none of them. The preview stays plain: it shows the draft and loads it again as a whole after each save.
preview.silent.title: The preview did not start in this browser
preview.silent.body: The site loaded in the frame but never said it was ready. Some browsers, Safari among them, do not send the site's cookie in a frame of another site, and an older frontend never says it. Open the preview in a new tab to see the saved draft there. The tab does not follow your saves: reload it to see them, and after 15 minutes press the button again.
preview.error.entry: The entry could not be loaded.
preview.error.unavailable: This site has no preview: set its url in the Content Manager (Site), and make sure the frontend runs there.
preview.error.forbidden: You may not preview this entry. It needs the permission to preview drafts and the permission to read the entry.
preview.error.unsupported: This type has no preview: its entries do not belong to a site.
preview.error.busy: Too many preview requests. Wait a minute, then reload.
preview.error.failed: The preview could not load. Reload to try again.
preview.error.popup: The browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for the admin and try again.
cost.title: Weight of the blocks
cost.meter: Weight of the page's blocks against its budget
cost.level.near: Close to the budget: {left} kB left.
cost.level.over: Over the budget by {over} kB. This page cannot be published.
cost.onDemand: Loaded only when used: {kb} kB, not counted in the weight.
cost.error.unavailable: The page could not be measured: the frontend did not give its weight to the admin. This does not affect publishing, which measures the page itself.
cost.error.forbidden: You may not measure this entry. It needs the permission to preview drafts and the permission to read the entry.
cost.error.busy: The frontend is limiting the measurements. Wait a minute, then measure again.
cost.error.failed: The page could not be measured. Try again.
cost.framework: Every page also sends {kb} kB of framework (script, styles, fonts), not counted against the budget.
cost.panel.never: Not measured yet. Measuring renders the saved draft once on the site.
cost.panel.stale: Of an earlier save: measure again to see the saved draft.
cost.panel.noSite: This site has no frontend to measure the page on. Publishing it is refused until it has one.
cost.panel.blocked: The admin's Content Security Policy does not let the page be measured here. The preview page says which setting is missing.
cost.panel.silent: The page could not be measured from the edit view. Open the preview to see its weight.
cost.panel.unsupported: This type has no page budget, so publishing it is not measured.
refusal.title: The page was not published
refusal.pageOverBudget: Its blocks weigh {weight} kB and its budget is {budget} kB, {over} kB over. Heaviest blocks: {blocks}.
refusal.previewUnavailable: It could not be measured against its budget, and a page is never published without that. {cause}
